contents.text: {"reason": "The agent's final answer gives a short one-minute description and then presents three offer cards via the Offer tool (tell me about your business, see a demo, walk me through this page), which serve as a single small nudge toward a question, a demo/page, or the chat. The criterion asks that the answer end with one small nudge; the answer ends with the offer cards, which is a nudge toward the chat and pages. However, the text itself ends with a description rather than an explicit nudge, and the offer offers three choices rather than one, so it is arguably not exactly one nudge.", "met": false}
